snippet.title: 최교진 교육장관 사퇴…“수능 책임 통감” / KBS 2026.11.22.
snippet.description:
최교진 교육부 장관이 오늘 사퇴했습니다. 수능을 앞두고, AI 부정행위에 대한 사전 대비가  미흡했다는 비판에 책임을 통감한다고 밝혔습니다. 이세연 기자의 보도입니다.

 [리포트]

 수능 이틀 전에야 '단추 스티커', 재난문자 발송 등 부정행위 방지 대책을 내놓은 정부.

 지난 5월 국가자격시험에서  스마트 안경 부정행위가 처음 적발된 뒤 유사 사례가 이어졌지만, 제대로 된 대책을 내놓지 못하다 '뒷북 대응'에 나섰다는 비판이 나왔습니다. 

[임지호/수험생/지난 18일 : "부정행위 하려면 충분히 할 사람은 할 수 있다고 생각하는데, 지금으로선 (특별한) 대책이 없으니까…."]

 장관의 부적절한 발언도 파장을 키웠습니다. 

[최교진/교육부 장관/지난 16일 : "(100% 잡아낼 자신 있어요?) 전 못 할 것 같습니다. 제 나이가 있어서…."]

 최교진 교육부 장관은 오늘 수능 준비 과정에서 빚어진 혼란에 책임을 지겠다며 사의를 표명했습니다.

 "수능을 목전에 두고 여러 가지 변화가 생겨 수험생을 포함한 국민 불편이 초래됐다"며 국민의 지적과 비판을 받아들이겠다고 밝혔습니다.

 정치권과 교원단체에 이어 고3 학생들까지 사퇴를 촉구하면서 사퇴 압박이 거세졌다는 분석입니다.

 청와대는 최 장관이 사의를 표명한 지 한 시간 만에 이재명 대통령이 이를 수락했다고 밝혔습니다.

 한편, 교육부는 과거 수능에서의 부정행위를 추적 조사하는 방안을 검토하고 있습니다.

 지난 시험에 대해서도 철저한 조사와 단죄를 요구한 이 대통령 지시에 따른 것으로 보입니다.

 하지만 시험지 보존 기한이 1년인 만큼 그보다 오래된 시험지는 이미 폐기됐을 가능성도 있어 조사에 한계가 있을 수 있다는 지적도 나옵니다.

Oil-Free Crispy Kanda Bhajiya in Minutes | Faber 24L Air Oven
Nothing beats hot, crispy Onion Bhajiya (Kanda Bhajiya) with a cup of evening chai—especially when you can enjoy that street-style crunch without deep-frying! Watch how easily you can make golden, crunchy onion fritters using the Faber 24L Air Oven.
Driven by 1500W power and stainless steel heating elements, the Faber Air Oven circulates intense, even heat around every bite—giving your bhajiyas crisp, golden edges and a soft, flavorful center using just a light brush of oil.
Why Cook with the Faber 24L Air Oven?
 • Large 24L Family Capacity: Cook big batches of evening snacks for the whole family in one go.
 • Precision Temperature Control: Dial in the exact heat needed for golden, crunchy results.
 • Adjustable Rack Positions: Flexible multi-level placement for uniform browning across the tray.
 • Smart Viewing & Timer: Monitor your food through the large observation window with the inner cavity lamp, while the 0–60 minute timer with bell-ring auto shut-off ensures zero overcooking.
 • Easy Cleanup: Features removable, dishwasher-safe accessories including the baking tray, crumb tray, and tray handle.
Ingredients

(Preheat the Air Oven for 5 minutes.)

 • Sliced Onion- 2
 • Besan- 1 Cup
 • Oil- 2-3 tbsp
 • Coriander Leaves1 2 tbsp
 • Turmeric Powder- 1 tbsp
 • Red Chilli Powder- 1 tbsp
 • Chopped Green Chillies- 1 
 • Carom Seeds- 1 tsp
 • Chaat Masala- 1 tbsp
 • Salt

METHOD

 • Add in Sliced Onion, Besan, Coriander Leaves, Turmeric Powder, Chopped Green Chillies, Carom Seeds, Oil & Salt. Mix well. Make a firm dry batter.

IN AIR OVEN 

 • Take a baking tray. Directly put the batter, shaped in Bhajiyas into small pieces only be one.
 • Spray some Oil over them
 • Set the Function Mode to Pan + Convection. Set the Timer to 15 Minutes. 

Serving

 • Serve with Sautéed Green Chillies & Chai. Enjoy!

বাংলাদেশের এক ছোট্ট মফস্বল শহরের সাধারণ এক পরিবারের অসাধারণ জীবনযুদ্ধের ও সম্পর্কের টানাপোড়েনের গল্প। অভাবের তাড়নায় ছেলে রাশেদ দূর শহরে কাজে গেলে, অহংকারী স্ত্রী সাবরিনা তার বৃদ্ধা শাশুড়ির ওপর চালায় চরম মানসিক নির্যাতন ও অপমান। কিন্তু নিয়তির বিচার বড়ই অদ্ভুত! অহংকারের পতন কীভাবে হলো আর মায়ের নিঃস্বার্থ ভালোবাসা ও ক্ষমা কীভাবে সব ভেঙে যাওয়া সম্পর্ক আবার জোড়া লাগালো—তা জানতে পুরো গল্পটি শেষ পর্যন্ত দেখুন।

এই গল্পটি আমাদের শেখায় যে, অহংকার মানুষকে একা করে দেয়, কিন্তু নিঃস্বার্থ ভালোবাসা এবং ক্ষমা যেকোনো কঠিন হৃদয়কেও জয় করতে পারে।

গল্পের মূল শিক্ষণীয় বিষয়:

মা-বাবার প্রতি সন্তানের দায়িত্ব ও ভালোবাসা।

অহংকার ও লোভের করুণ পরিণতি।

নিঃস্বার্থ ক্ষমা ও পারিবারিক বন্ধনের গুরুত্ব।

গল্পটি ভালো লাগলে ভিডিওটিতে একটি লাইক দিন, আপনার মূল্যবান মতামত কমেন্টে জানান এবং এমন আরও হৃদয়স্পর্শী ও শিক্ষণীয় গল্প পেতে চ্যানেলটি সাবস্ক্রাইব করে পাশে থাকুন।

snippet.title: Why Is He Smiling Between Two Tigers? 🐯
snippet.description:
A monk hangs from a vine on a cliff. A tiger is above him and a tiger is below him. Two mice are chewing through his only vine. He climbs, he shouts and he prays, and nothing works. Then he sees one small thing.
An old Zen story about the one thing we keep missing.

What's your "strawberry" today? Tell me in the comments.

Retold from the Zen parable of the man, the two tigers and the strawberry ("A Parable", Zen Flesh, Zen Bones, no. 18). The mice as day and night come from the "man in the well" parable in the Mahabharata. The monk, his climbs and prayer, the strand countdown, the tiger lying down and the other people on the cliff are our own telling.

snippet.description: Misty raced for eight years and spent the next eleven in a field in County Durham, England. She had never seen the sea. Then she pawed the water once and trotted straight into the sea. Claire had to run in after her. Subscribe if Misty goes back next year.

snippet.title: 무섭게 오른 원자잿값..부품업계 덮친 공포 / 경제365 / SBS 10시뉴스
snippet.description:
[경제 365]

메모리반도체 값이 오르는 이른바 칩플레이션이 가전과 스마트폰 업계를 덮친 가운데, 전자부품 원자잿값도 1년 새 크게 뛰었습니다.

삼성전기의 3분기 보고서를 보면, 올해 3분기까지 누적 원재료 매입 비용은 3조 8천517억 원으로, 1년 전보다 18.2% 늘었습니다.

특히 기판 사업을 맡는 패키지솔루션 부문은 43.8% 급증했습니다.

LG이노텍도 누적 원재료 매입액이 14조 4천670억 원으로 22% 증가했습니다.

이들에게서 부품을 받는 완제품 업체의 부담도 커졌습니다.

삼성전자의 누적 원재료 비용은 95조 5천978억 원으로, 1년 전보다 10조 5천억 원가량 늘었습니다.

LG전자 에코솔루션사업본부는 열교환기용 구리 매입액이 37.9% 급증하면서, 원재료 매입액이 18.1% 늘었습니다.

snippet.title: I Tried to Save GTA6's Most Doomed NPC (And Lost My Mind)
snippet.description:
In Grand Theft Auto 6, there is a man at a gas station who is programmed to do one thing: fill a bathtub with gasoline while smoking a cigarette, peel out in his truck, and explode.

That is his entire existence. So I reloaded my save, hit my mailbox for good luck, and set out to answer one simple question: Can you actually break an NPC out of a rigged, scripted death? And if you manage to save someone who was never supposed to survive, what do they do after?

Thanks for watching, thanks for being here.

snippet.title: Budae Jjigae | Korean Army Stew with SPAM & Ramen #budaejjigae #koreanfood #foodanimation
snippet.description:
Team SPAM or team kimchi? Tell me what goes in your pot first 👇

The American team (SPAM and sausages) and the Korean team (kimchi and gochujang) start a fight on the kitchen table. Then SPAM dives into the golden pot, kimchi jumps in after it, and the sausages, tofu, rice cakes and green onion follow one by one. A can of SPAM cheers from the rim, a red ball of seasoning paste lands on the kimchi, and golden broth pours in. On a little gas burner the stew boils hard, instant ramen slides into the middle, and a slice of American cheese melts on top.

Budae jjigae means "army base stew." It started after the Korean War (1950-53) near the US army bases in Uijeongbu, where people cooked SPAM, sausages and baked beans with kimchi, gochujang and garlic. Today it's a favorite Korean comfort food, finished with ramen noodles and a slice of cheese.

이것은 갤러리인가 가정집인가?

부부는 브라질로 이민 가 30년간 누구보다 성실한 인생 2막을 보냈다. 의류업을 하고, 자녀를 키우고 또 손주를 보며 인생 2막이 점점 정리되어 갔다. 남편 김성언 씨는 이민 가고 나서 단 한 순간도 한국에 돌아오겠다는 생각을 접은 적이 없다고 말한다. 돌아가야지, 언젠간 돌아가야지 하며 예순이 되었다.

수려할 뿐 아니라 정말 성처럼 단단한 이 집에서 드디어 부부만의 시간을 보낼 수 있게 되었다. 날개를 편 돌집은 처음 맞는 둘만의 여유로운 시간이 영원하기를 바라는 마음이 담겼다. 고생한 아내를 생각하는 남편의 마음이 곳곳에 담긴 집에서 아내 전성자 씨는 “이 집에서는 백 년도 남편과 살 수 있을 것 같다”고 말하고, 건축탐구 집의 프리젠터인 노은주, 임형남 건축가는 이 집은 백 년이 아니라 천년도 살 수 있을 거라고 답한다.

snippet.title: Grande Reportagem: Roberto Cabrini investiga morte de pichador encontrado sem vida no Tietê
snippet.description:
A morte de André Ferreira Rodrigues, conhecido como Oludum, está cercada de mistérios. Aos 49 anos, ele foi visto fugindo de um condomínio na Vila Leopoldina antes de seu corpo ser encontrado no rio Tietê, dias depois. A polícia investiga se foi um acidente ou resultado de uma perseguição violenta.

Na madrugada de 21 de outubro, câmeras registraram André saindo às pressas do condomínio após uma pichação. Um grupo o seguiu até a Marginal Tietê. Dias depois, seu corpo foi encontrado no rio em Santana do Parnaíba.

André, além de pichador, era conhecido por sua alegria, conforme relatos de familiares. Ele trabalhava como auxiliar de laboratório e iniciou na pichação na adolescência.

मंगोल के सुल्तान अत्तर खान शहंशाह अकबर और बीरबल से मदद माँगने आते हैं! मंगोल के कैदखाने में एक बेहद खौफनाक 'इंसानी सांप' कैद है जिसके दो दांत जैसे निकले हैं और जिसका काटा पल भर में दम तोड़ देता है! यहां तक ​​कि सुल्तान के पिता को दुश्मन बशीर चिश्ती ने अगवा कर रखा है और इस दरिंदे की रिहाई की सख्त राखी है।
क़ैदखाने में बंद होने के बाद ये दरिंदा सिपाहियों को दास बना दिया गया। सबको लग रहा था कि जहर इस इंसान के भीतर है! पर चतुर बीरबल की तीखी नज़र ज़मीन पर पड़ी सांप की केंचुली (सांप की खाल) और एक कोने के एक छोटे से बिल पर पड़ती है!

कैसे बीरबल ने सपेरा और बीन की धुन से असली काले सांप का पर्दाफूश किया? और कैसे 'जहर को जहर ही काटता है' की अनोखी योजना से बशीर के महल में हजारों सांपों को छोड़ कर बिना एक भी बूंद खून बहाए सुल्तान के पिता को रिहा करवाया? देखिये इस बेहद रोमांटिक कहानी में!

Mongol ke Sultan Attar Khan Shahenshah Akbar aur Birbal se madad maangne aate hain! Mongol ke qaidkhane mein ek behad khaufnaak 'Insaani Saanp' qaid hai jiske do daant saanp jaise nikle hain aur jiska kaata pal bhar mein dum tod deta hai! Yahan tak ki Sultan ke pita ko dushman Basheer Chishti ne aghwa kar rakha hai aur is darinde ki rihaai ki shart rakhi hai.
Qaidkhane mein band hone ke bawajood yeh darinda sipahiyon ko das raha tha. Sabko lag raha tha ki zehar is insaan ke bheetar hai! Par chatur Birbal ki teekhi nazar zameen par padi saanp ki kenchuli (snake skin) aur kone ke ek chote se bill par padti hai!

Kaise Birbal ne sapera aur been ki dhun se asli kaale saanp ka pardafoosh kiya? Aur kaise 'Zehar ko Zehar Hi Kaat-ta Hai' ki anokhi yojana se Basheer ke mahal mein hazaron saanpon ko chhodkar bina ek bhi boond khoon bahaye Sultan ke pita ko riha karwaya? Dekhiye is behad romanchak animated kahani mein!
